caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden figure rendered in pencil on a light tan background. The figure appears humanoid, consisting of a head, torso, two arms, and two legs. The head has a helmet-like cap with vertical and horizontal lines etched on it and facial features that include eyes, a nose, and a closed mouth. The torso is cylindrical and tapers slightly towards the waist, with the bottom flaring out to suggest a skirt or tunic. The arms are long and straight, each ending in a broad, paddle-like object instead of hands. The legs are straight cylinders, ending in slightly wider rectangular feet; the left leg’s foot is drawn marginally behind the right, suggesting a stance. All parts are uniformly shaded in gray tones, with some areas darker to show shadow or depth. The limbs are attached in a way that suggests possible articulation at the shoulders and hips. The background is empty except for a simple rectangular border framing the figure and a small scale bar labeled in inches, along with the name "Bernard Westmacott" at the bottom right.
title: Whirligig
